svg.aria-label: A bot in an ELU session: @reviewer is added to a new session, reviews the agent's change under its own name, asks for one fix, and passes the change once it is fixed.
svg.title: A bot in an ELU session: @reviewer is added to a new session, reviews the agent's change under its own name, asks for one fix, and passes the change once it is fixed.

g.text: Reviews each change for correctness, security, performance and maintainability
Bots review the changes. Type @name to add one or to write to it.
@reviewer is in this session. It reviews the changes.
Nothing is changed yet. One Task is below for your approval.
Goal: Coupon codes compare equal whatever their case.
1. normalize returns the code in upper case
You add the bot @reviewer to a new session.
It will review each change. You ask for one.
You approve the Task. Opus makes the change.
@reviewer finds one thing to fix. Opus works on it.
Opus fixed it. @reviewer reviews again: Passed.
